environment_blocker.detail: This analysis session's exec sandbox silently drops or EPERMs file writes whose content derives from files created outside the session (proven by controlled tests: same-process copies of foreign files land 0-byte; self-generated content writes fine; long-running/backgrounded writers also lose writes). Blender therefore cannot save GLBs/renders from THIS session. muse.write/muse.edit (tool path) work — all text deliverables were produced through them. Production was therefore packaged as a self-contained run-book (treat.py + EXECUTOR-BRIEF.md) and delegated to an executor subagent session; if that session hits the same wall it must report it, and the parent (whose session demonstrably writes foreign content fine — it copied the 4 intake blends + hashed them) can run treat.py directly.
